IGUI_SPESS_Item_Aerogenerador_Tooltip: Wind turbine. Produces variable power based on wind speed and weather.
IGUI_SPESS_Item_BatteryTank_Tooltip: Solar battery. Stores surplus energy to cover demand when production drops.
IGUI_SPESS_Item_EnergyController_Tooltip: ERS controller. Coordinates production, batteries, and building power state.
IGUI_SPESS_Item_SolarPanelHorizontal_Too: Horizontal solar panel. Compact variant for daytime energy production.
IGUI_SPESS_Item_SolarPanelIndividual_Too: Solar panel spare part. Used to repair damaged solar panels.
IGUI_SPESS_Item_SolarPanel_Tooltip: Vertical solar panel. Produces daytime energy and must be connected to the controller.
IGUI_SPESS_Item_TurbinaHidraulica_Toolti: Hydraulic turbine. Stable output when installed on flowing water and connected to a controller.
IGUI_SPESS_Item_TurbineHelice_Tooltip: Hydraulic turbine impeller. Used to repair damaged hydraulic turbines.
IGUI_SPESS_Item_WindBattery_Tooltip: Wind battery. Stores turbine energy for later use.
IGUI_SPESS_Item_WindTurbineMotor_Tooltip: Wind turbine spare motor. Used to repair damaged wind turbines.
IGUI_SPESS_Item_WireTransferEnergy_Toolt: Transfer cable. Links panels, turbines, and batteries to the controller.
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_CableSpawnAm: Controls how many energy transfer cables appear together when a cable spawns in loot.
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_ConsumerScan: How often the controller performs a periodic full consumer cache refresh. Dirty events still force an immediate refresh.
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_ControllerVe: How many floors above and below the controller are included for energy distribution and consumer scans (0 = same floor only).
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_DebugLogs_to: Enables verbose ERS console logging for debugging. Keep disabled on servers to avoid spam.
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_EconomicMode: Fixed watt requirement consumed by the economic mode while the controller is powering the building. Set 0 to allow any available ERS energy.
Radius around the controller used by economic whole-building power. Default is 20 tiles.
